members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2490: RequestResponder cancel-scope lifecycle is mismanaged: __enter__ was recreating the CancelScope (so pre-entry cancel() targeted a different scope than the handler ran under), and __exit__ was propagating spurious cancellation exceptions when the request was already completed. Both PRs fix different sides of the same root cause — incorrect cancel-scope ownership across the RequestResponder lifecycle.

members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2514: RequestResponder.cancel() is not spec-compliant: it was sending an error response for cancelled requests (which the spec forbids) instead of a CancelledNotification. Both PRs modify the same cancel() method — #2493 removes the incorrect error-response send and #2514 adds the correct CancelledNotification send. They are two halves of the same fix and conflict at the same lines.
